faces.name: Segante, Doing Crimes
faces.oracleText:
{X}{B}{G}: Target creature an opponent controls gets -X/-X until end of turn. Another target creature you control gets +X/+X until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery.
At the beginning of your end step, target player gains life equal to the total amount of life lost by your opponents this turn. If a player other than you gains life this way, draw a card.
